name: port-walkthrough
title: Port a generateText loop

origin.source: The hand-rolled support loop from docs/from-a-loop.md, ported line for line and pinned by tests

comparison.purpose: The short, linear version of retrofit. before.ts is the generateText while-loop from docs/from-a-loop.md, runnable with a key. index.ts is the same agent as a machine run with runAgent, with the same call signature and result type. index.test.ts runs it on a mock model with no key, shows the step limit settling done in failed, pauses for approval and resumes from a JSON snapshot, and proves with canReach that no path sends an email without approval.
